lines: Drone Dogs leapt at Saitou from the ground,
And Drone Wasps from the air.
「To think I would be forced to fight machines...」
However, the drones' claws and fangs would easily tear the likes of a soft human body apart.
（All right, how're you gonna fight against that?!）
The expressionless man sidestepped the drones' attacks through exquisite martial arts, just as he had handled the three underlings.
（Those martial arts are great. I'll praise you for that. But even if you have four arms, what're you gonna do, barehanded? Eh, Serial Killer-san?!）
Saitou's right hand (the one that had been there from the beginning) gently touched a Drone Dog's head.
Whatever it was he did, and however he did it, the Drone Dog's head was blown off.
This time, his left hand (the one that had sprouted later) lightly pushed the body of a Drone Wasp.
As before, a small explosion occurred, and the Drone Wasp simply broke into pieces.
Without altering the look on his face at all, Saitou emotionlessly destroyed the drones as though he were performing some routine work.
（Is he hiding miniature explosives on him or something? Well, he was never gonna be truly unarmed, right?）
It wasn't like Kageomi was idly watching the drones get destroyed.
He had been quietly nearing Saitou.
He was caught up in taking on the drones, and exposing his defenceless back to Kageomi.
His face wasn't surprised at all. He was still acting cocky.
Despite feeling that something was slightly off, Kageomi was about to attack Saitou, when at that moment,
All of a sudden, Saitou's figure disappeared.
It had not been done through martial arts.
He had literally vanished all of a sudden.
“Growing two arms isn't his only ninja art?!”
“Does this mean he still has a secret?!”
「Didn't I tell you that I'm always the one doing the hunting?」
That voice had come from behind Kageomi.
If he moved, he would be killed.
All of Kageomi's hair stood on end.
An uncomfortable sweat seeped out from his entire body.
「A cautious assassin. But no match for me.」
「What the hell is your ninja art?!」
Moist breaths were breathed on Kageomi's ear.
「There are two types of murder. One is murder as an ideology. The other is hedonistic murder of the highborn.」
「You're serial killing for your own pleasure?」
「It would appear you still don't understand. That would be the former. It is merely culling.」
「Culling, you say? Then, who's the highborn?」
And he had said that in an enraptured manner.
「I will be the man to surpass Igawa Asagi.」
A cold hand had touched Kageomi's cheek.
It was like the hand of a corpse.
It seemed that way to him.
「Do you get it? I am destined to be the true ubermensch.」
「And you are nothing more than herde, a mere weakling.」
The corpse's hand moved away from his cheek.
Just like the drones, which had all been destroyed.
Having lost his head, his body limply collapsed on the spot.
